nodes.label: Authenticate Server Actions Like API Routes
nodes.rationale: Impact CRITICAL. Middleware, layout guards and page-level checks can all be bypassed because the action endpoint is callable directly, so authentication and authorization must live inside the action body. Prescribed order: validate input (zod), then authenticate the session, then authorize the specific resource, then mutate.

nodes.label: Server Actions Are Public Endpoints
nodes.rationale: A 'use server' function is compiled into a public-facing endpoint; Next.js documentation states it must carry the same security considerations as an API route.
